full_text_zh:
[P1] YUE DU YUE MEI
悦读阅美
MILI DE
DA MIMI
米丽的大秘密
恩纳特·施沃宝达 图 安格丽卡·格里兹 文 陈俊 译
21 二十一世纪出版社
21st Century Publishing House

[P2] 跳橡皮筋的时候，米丽笑着对鲁迪说：“我有一个大秘密。”
她的笑容好古怪哟。

[P3] “什么秘密？”鲁迪问。
“可是……可是……秘密
怎么能随便告诉别人呢？”米丽说。
“我是世界上最棒的解开
秘密的能手。”鲁迪心想。他又
好奇又激动，想着想着，双脚
都被橡皮筋给缠住了。

[P4] 是一只令人恶心的毒蜘蛛吗？
是一个臭气炸弹……
或者是一只黏糊的癞蛤蟆？
一个又一个的谜底在他脑子里打转。米丽能有什么秘密呢？
“我敢打赌，你有一只令人恶心的毒蜘蛛！”
“一只小小的蜘蛛？”
米丽又笑了，“去你的吧！它比蜘蛛大得太多了！”
唰——她松开橡皮筋，独自跑开了。鲁迪本想跟着她，可是橡皮筋又把他给缠住了。

[P5] 鲁迪自个儿跑回家，
他边跑边叫：“米丽有一个大秘密！”一不留心，
他在门廊里给绊了一跤。
“也许是一个漂亮的胸针吧。”妈妈应声道。鲁迪心想妈妈对解密一点也不在行。他决定还是独自解开这个谜。

[P6] 下午，他在芦苇塘边等着米丽。
“我猜肯定是古代勇士的头盔！”鲁迪说。
“乱说！”米丽又笑了，“它比头盔大一千倍，重一千倍还不止呢！”
比头盔大一千倍……
比头盔重一千倍？
到底是什么东西呢？

[P7] 是不是一条巨蟒？
要么是她发现了海盗的宝藏？
或者是一条八
条腿的大章鱼？
或者是飞碟？

[P8] 直到第二天上午，鲁迪也没有能想出个究竟。
于是他化妆成吸血蝙蝠，朝正在沙坑旁玩耍的米丽冲去。
“噢呜——”他的喉咙里发出可怕的吼声，“噢呜——快把秘密告诉我，不然，我就吸你的血！
可是米丽立即就认出了他。
因为鲁迪忘记在嘴里插上蝙蝠牙了。傻瓜！

[P9] “好吧。我们俩来交换。我送你两粒大弹子，只要你肯把秘密告诉我！”鲁迪说。
遗憾的是米丽根本不稀罕弹子。她发现
那弹子上还黏着隔夜的口香糖，真恶心！

可是她给了鲁迪一个提示。她总是这样子！“它是灰色的。”她轻轻地说。说完，她
就一蹦一跳地走了。

“这东西是灰色的？”鲁迪绞尽脑汁，“它会不会长着一双大耳朵？外加一条老长老长的鼻子？”

[P10] 忽然，门铃响了，米丽站在大门前。“跟我来吧，我把秘密告诉你。”米丽叫道，“跟朋友分享秘密要有趣得多！”
“米丽也许拥有一头大象了！”鲁迪回家告诉爸爸妈妈，“可是我呢？我只有一只傻乎乎的天竺鼠！”
“米丽有没有大象用得着你操什么心！”妈妈没好气地说。

[P11] 他们俩跑过大街……
穿过村庄……
走过草地……
……爬过一座座小山……
……钻过一座森林，
米丽这才立住了脚。

[P12] “嘘——”米丽压低嗓门，
用双手扒开一簇厚厚的叶子。
“喏，就是这里。这是我的
大石头。从这里……”

“一块大石头？”鲁迪大失所
望，“这么一块无聊的破石头？”
“你好好看看，它在太阳下闪
闪发光哩。”米丽显出一副陶醉的
样子。

[P13] “呸——”鲁迪不屑一顾，“这种东西只有丫头片子才会感兴趣！
“可是你听我说……”
米丽请求道。
鲁迪压根儿就不想听，
他早就转身跑开不见踪影了。
于是米丽只有一个人爬上那块大石头。
爬上这块全世界独一无二的大石头，从那里可以看到……

[P14] ……一只庞大无比的湖中
怪兽正在水中快活地嬉戏。
full_text_en:
[P1] YUE DU YUE MEI
Reading and Appreciating Beauty
MILI DE
DA MIMI
Mili's Big Secret
Illustrations by Ennat Shiwu BaoDa, Text by Angelika Gritz, Translated by Chen Jun
21 21st Century Publishing House
21st Century Publishing House

[P2] While jumping rope, Milly smiled at Rudy and said, "I have a big secret." 
Her smile was so strange.

[P3] "What secret?" Rudy asked.
"But... but... how can a secret
be told to someone else?" Milly said.
"I'm the best secret-solver in the world," Rudy thought. He was
both curious and excited, thinking and thinking, until his feet
were tangled in the rubber bands.

[P4] Is it a disgusting poisonous spider?
Is it a stink bomb...
Or a slimy toad?
One riddle after another spun through his mind. What secret could Milly have?
"I'll bet you have a disgusting poisonous spider!"
"A tiny little spider?"
Milly laughed again, "Forget it! It's much bigger than a spider!"
Swoosh—she let go of the jump rope and ran off by herself. Rudy wanted to follow her, but the rope tangled him up again.

[P5] Rudy ran home by himself,
shouting as he ran: "Milly has a big secret!" He wasn't paying attention,
and tripped in the hallway.
"Maybe it's a pretty brooch," Mom replied. Rudy thought Mom wasn't any good at solving mysteries. He decided to solve this puzzle by himself.

[P6] In the afternoon, he waited for Milly by the reed pond.
"I bet it's an ancient warrior's helmet!" said Rudy.
"Nonsense!" Milly laughed again. "It's a thousand times bigger than a helmet, and weighs a thousand times more!"
A thousand times bigger than a helmet...
A thousand times heavier than a helmet?
What on earth could it be?

[P7] Could it be a giant snake?
Or maybe she discovered a pirate's treasure?
Or perhaps an eight-legged giant octopus?
Or maybe a flying saucer?

[P8] Until the next morning, Rudy couldn't figure it out.
So he dressed up as a vampire bat and rushed toward Milli, who was playing by the sandbox.
"Ooh-oooh—" he growled terrifyingly, "Ooh-oooh—tell me your secret, or I'll suck your blood!"
But Milli immediately recognized him.
Because Rudy had forgotten to put the bat teeth in his mouth. Fool!

[P9] "Alright. Let's trade. I'll give you two big marbles, as long as you tell me your secret!" said Rudy.
Unfortunately, Millie didn't care about the marbles. She noticed
that the marbles were still sticky with yesterday's chewing gum. Yuck!

But she gave Rudy a hint. She always did! "It's gray," she said softly. Then she
hopped away.

"This thing is gray?" Rudy thought hard. "Could it have big ears? And a super-long nose?"

[P10] Suddenly, the doorbell rang, and Milli stood at the front door. "Come with me, I'll tell you my secret," Milli called out, "It's much more fun to share secrets with friends!"
"Maybe Milli has an elephant!" Rudy told his parents when he got home. "But what about me? I only have a silly little guinea pig!"
"Does it matter whether Milli has an elephant or not?" Mom said, exasperated.

[P11] They ran down the street...
Through the village...
Across the meadow...
...climbed over hill after hill...
...and squeezed through a forest,
before Milly finally stopped.

[P12] "Shhh—" Miri lowered her voice,
using both hands to part a thick cluster of leaves.
"There it is. This is my
big stone. From here..."

"A big stone?" Rudi was greatly disappointed, "Such a boring, useless rock?"
"Look closely, it's sparkling in the sunlight," Miri said, looking utterly enchanted.

[P13] "Pfft—" Rudy dismissed it with a sneer, "Only a little girl would be interested in something like this!"
"But you have to listen to me..." 
Milly pleaded.
Rudy didn't even want to hear it;
he had already turned and run off, disappearing into the distance.
So Milly climbed the big rock all by herself.
Climbing this one-of-a-kind rock in the whole world, from there you could see...

[P14] ……A huge lake monster is playing happily in the water.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《米丽的大秘密》的封面，展示了书名、作者、译者及出版社信息，画面中一个红发女孩正凑近一个白发男孩耳边说悄悄话，男孩则托腮思考，背景为橙红色天空。
[P2] 米丽在跳橡皮筋时笑着告诉鲁迪自己有一个大秘密，她的笑容显得很古怪。
[P3] 鲁迪询问米丽的秘密，米丽表示秘密不能随便告诉别人，鲁迪心想自己是解开秘密的能手，结果因过于激动而被橡皮筋缠住双脚。
[P4] 鲁迪猜测米丽的秘密可能是一只毒蜘蛛、臭气炸弹或癞蛤蟆，但米丽笑着否认并表示秘密比蜘蛛大得多。随后她松开橡皮筋跑开，鲁迪想跟上却被橡皮筋缠住。
[P5] 鲁迪跑回家告诉妈妈米丽有一个大秘密，途中被绊了一跤。妈妈猜测秘密可能是一个漂亮的胸针，但鲁迪认为妈妈不擅长解密，决定独自解开这个谜题。
[P6] 鲁迪在芦苇塘边等待米丽，猜测她的秘密是古代勇士的头盔，但米丽笑着否认，并强调秘密比头盔大一千倍、重一千倍还不止，引发鲁迪对秘密究竟是什么的疑惑。
[P7] 鲁迪继续猜测米丽的秘密，想象它可能是一条巨蟒、海盗宝藏、八条腿的大章鱼或飞碟，画面以四格漫画形式展现了他的各种幻想。
[P8] 鲁迪为了破解米丽的秘密，装扮成吸血蝙蝠去吓唬她，但因忘记戴蝙蝠牙而被米丽认出，计划失败。
[P9] 鲁迪试图用弹珠交换米丽的秘密，但米丽嫌弃弹珠脏而拒绝。她只给鲁迪一个提示：秘密是灰色的。鲁迪据此展开想象，猜测秘密可能有大耳朵和长鼻子。
[P10] 鲁迪根据米丽的提示猜测她的秘密可能是一头大象，并回家告诉父母，但妈妈对此不以为然。随后米丽来到鲁迪家，邀请他一起去分享秘密。
[P11] 鲁迪和米丽一起奔跑，穿过大街、村庄、草地、小山和森林，最终米丽停了下来。
[P12] 米丽带领鲁迪来到森林中的一块大石头前，宣布这就是她的秘密，鲁迪对此感到失望，认为它无聊，而米丽则陶醉于石头在阳光下闪闪发光的样子。
[P13] 鲁迪对米丽的秘密感到不屑并跑开，米丽独自爬上一块大石头，准备从那里分享她的秘密。
[P14] 鲁迪想象米丽的秘密是一只在湖中嬉戏的庞大怪兽，画面中他趴在石头上，看着水中的绿色怪兽和它背上的小鸟。
